_about: Single source of truth for the Trip DNA film. Scene lengths, voice timing and on-screen captions are all derived from this file by mix.py and build_html.py. Lines marked bubble:true are the exact words printed in the manga speech bubbles.

girl.direction: a young anime heroine on her first trip to Japan; light, bright, expressive, slightly breathy

app.direction: a calm, warm, reassuring travel-assistant voice heard through earphones

lines.text: まもなく、二番線に、電車がまいります。黄色い線まで、お下がりください。
So many people... Where do I go?
lines.emotion: overwhelmed and small, almost whispering, a nervous breath before speaking

lines.text: 新幹線のりばは、二階でございます。

lines.emotion: lost and quietly defeated, trailing off

lines.text: Oh, and my train departed already?!
lines.emotion: sudden shock, voice jumping upward, anime-style panic
small and helpless, close to tears

scenes.caption: As the worry fades, Japan fills with colour.

lines.emotion: a hopeful gasp, then brightening with curiosity
delighted relief, a happy little laugh in the voice

lines.text: Welcome to Japan. Let's find your way.
Your route is ready. Platform fourteen, in five minutes.

lines.emotion: confident and playful, a big smile you can hear

lines.text: Sugoi... Lanterns, sakura, takoyaki... This is the Japan I dreamed of!
lines.emotion: joyful wonder, breathless and sparkling, like the end of an anime episode

lines.text: Trip DNA! Less worry. More culture!
lines.emotion: bright and proud, smiling, looking straight at the audience
